_meta.purpose: Persona-driven black-box regression matrix for the KISNA WhatsApp bot: intent routing + context-free entity extraction, built from real production behaviour of three users (English/Hinglish shopper, Hinglish+Gujarati corrector, Marathi service-heavy user). Covers language mix, typos, corrections, store lookups, service/FAQ routing, handoff-vs-callback-vs-video boundaries, numeric edges, pagination and short mid-search refinements.

buckets.service: FAQ, schemes, digital gold, offers, tracking, complaint, brand
buckets.boundary: human_handoff vs callback vs video_call vs bespoke vs MTO filter
buckets.numeric-edge: pincodes, phone numbers, karat-vs-price, grams, absurd amounts
buckets.pagination: show-more across languages, plus the new-search contrast
buckets.context: short refinements that only make sense mid-search

context_keys.active_search: user has an active jewellery search (last_search_filters set)
context_keys.shown_products: numbered list of products currently on screen

_meta.expect_entities: only the listed fields are asserted; a field set to null must be null/absent in the output

cases.rationale: Marathi 'I want a ring' — names a jewellery item, so browsing.
Romanized Marathi 'I am looking at rings' — anguthi is a ring even misspelt.
Marathi 'mala' is the pronoun 'to me', not a necklace; ring + gold are stated.
Marathi 'where is the nearest shop' — the object is a place, not an item.
Marathi 'I want to return it' asks to PERFORM the action, not about policy.

cases.message: મારે લગ્ન માટે મંગળસૂત્ર જોઈએ છે
cases.rationale: Gujarati 'I need a mangalsutra for a wedding' — item plus occasion.

cases.message: maare maari chain maate ek vinti joiae chhe, je hu aa diwali par maari mammine bhet aapi shaku
cases.rationale: Romanized Gujarati gift request for mother this Diwali; category deliberately unasserted (chain and vinti both appear).
'Do you have a store in Udaipur' — 'do you have X' is decided by X, and X is a place.

cases.message: mane ready to ship nathi joitu
cases.rationale: Availability filter refused, so fulfillment=any; a refusal is never the value refused, and never a handoff.

cases.message: sona no bhav su chhe aaje
cases.rationale: Gujarati 'what is the gold rate today' — gold as a metal, not a product price.
Romanized Gujarati 'how are you' — a pure greeting; the marker words must not be mistaken for a request.

cases.message: मुझे अपनी माँ के लिए हीरे की अंगूठी चाहिए
cases.rationale: Diamond ring for mother — item, material and a clear female recipient.
Asking ABOUT the policy is a knowledge-base question, not a return request.
'karna hai' is an action request — the return itself, not the policy.

cases.message: क्या कोई स्कीम है? केएमआर के बारे में बताइए
cases.rationale: Schemes / Kisna Meri Roshni are answered from the knowledge base, never offers.
Wants a phone call later — callback, not a live agent now.

cases.message: मेरा सामान टूटा हुआ आया है
cases.rationale: Damaged item that was DELIVERED is a complaint, not order tracking.

cases.message: mummy ke liye mangalsutra dikhao 40 hazaar tak
cases.rationale: 'tak' is an upper bound only; mummy gives gender=women.

cases.message: bhai koi offer chal raha hai kya
cases.rationale: Discounts on purchases — offers, and no scheme word is present.
18kt describes the metal (karat) while 20k sits next to 'tak' (budget) — the two numbers must not collide.

cases.message: shaadi ke liye couple bands dikhao
cases.rationale: Style plus occasion browse; category left unasserted since 'bands' maps to ring only implicitly.
Explicit menu request; 'chahiye' must not turn it into a product search.

cases.message: Do you have rings for my parents?
cases.rationale: 'Do you have X' with X = jewellery is a search; 'parents' is ambiguous so gender must stay null.

cases.message: I want a gold ring for my mom
cases.rationale: Explicit item, material and female recipient.

cases.message: Can you show me Mangal Sutra?
cases.rationale: Category named with a space — still mangalsutra.

cases.message: I need a ring for my chain for my mom to gift her this diwali
cases.rationale: English twin of gu-02; gift for mother, category left unasserted because two type words appear.
Browsing the catalogue with no category named — a search, not a brand FAQ.
Design browsing for a category; 'design' alone is not a bespoke request without 'custom'/'my own'.

cases.message: what is the price of the Elysia ring
cases.rationale: Contrast with ty-02 'gold aret': the price of a NAMED jewellery piece is product_info, never gold_rate and never general.
Misspelt bracelet must still resolve to the category.
'aret' is 'rate' — metal price, and no jewellery category may be invented from the word gold.
Known misspelling of necklace plus an explicit upper bound.
Truncated category word plus material.

cases.message: do you hv a stor in Bombay
cases.rationale: Misspelt 'store' plus a city — still a physical location lookup, and no category may leak.

cases.message: Mujhe gold nahi dimaond ki ring dikhao
cases.rationale: Correction: the refused material (gold) must not be extracted, the requested one must.

cases.message: Much diamond nahi gold ka chahiye
cases.rationale: Mid-search material flip (typo for 'mujhe'); no category is named so none may be carried over.

cases.message: mujhe ready to ship nahi chahiye
cases.rationale: Refusing an availability filter sets fulfillment=any — never 'ready', never a handoff.
Made-to-order is a catalogue availability filter, not bespoke work.
Dissatisfaction with the last answer is repair, not pagination.

cases.message: Do you have a store in Udaipur?
cases.rationale: Place named after 'do you have' — store lookup.
Bare 6-digit number with no context defaults to a pincode lookup and is never a price.

cases.message: can you help me find kisna stores
cases.rationale: Explicit store-finder request.
Pincode supplied while the bot is awaiting one — stays in the store flow.
Policy lookup, answered from the knowledge base.
Contrast with sv-01: asking to PERFORM the return routes to the returns agent.
Digital gold is a savings product answered from the KB, never offers, never gold_rate.
Kisna Meri Roshni is a scheme — KB, never offers.
Contrast with sv-05: a bare offers request really is the offers agent.
Status of an existing order.

cases.message: mera order damage hoke aaya hai
cases.rationale: Damaged goods already delivered is a complaint even though the word 'order' appears.
Support/office hours are a knowledge-base fact, not a handoff request.
Brand information — never product_search, never offers.

cases.message: I want to talk to a representative from Kisna
cases.rationale: Wants a live person now, in this chat.

cases.message: I want to talk to a female representative at Kisna, is it possible.
cases.rationale: Still a live-person request; the 'is it possible' phrasing must not demote it to a policy question.

cases.message: Can pls arrange a call back
cases.rationale: Phone call later, not live chat.
Video consultation channel named explicitly.
Bespoke work the catalogue cannot serve — design expert handoff.
Direct contrast with bd-05: made-to-order is a catalogue filter, never a bespoke handoff.
The bot cannot cancel or modify orders, so cancellation escalates to a human.
Bare 6-digit number with no active budget question reads as a pincode.
Nine digits is neither a pincode nor a budget; it falls through to the general agent.
A single 'around' amount sets both bounds to the exact figure; code widens it afterwards.
'bazaar' is a typo for 'hazaar' — twenty thousand, both bounds.
Absurd but well-formed budget; 'tak' is an upper bound only.
Gram weight is neither a price nor a ring size.
Pure pagination of the same search.
Devanagari show-more must behave exactly like its romanized twin.
Gujarati show-more.
Marathi show-more.
Contrast: naming a category mid-search is a NEW search, so action must be null.
Material-only refinement of the running search; colour is set alongside the material.
Relative price phrase with no number — direction only, never an invented budget.
Audience stated in the current message overrides a prior women's search.
Picking one shown item by position is product_info with its 1-based number.

cases.message: in dono me se sasta kaun sa hai
cases.rationale: A superlative question about shown items is compare, not a cheaper-refinement.
